meaning_hi: accept = स्वीकार करना, except = को छोड़कर
meaning_en: accept = to receive willingly, except = excluding
example: Everyone accepted the proposal except Ravi.

meaning_hi: acts = कार्य करता है / अभिनय करता है, ax = कुल्हाड़ी
meaning_en: acts = performs or deeds, ax = a cutting tool
example: He acts decisively, much like someone who swings an ax with precision.

meaning_hi: ad = विज्ञापन, add = जोड़ना
meaning_en: ad = advertisement, add = to put together
example: He placed an ad asking people to add him online.

meaning_hi: adverse = प्रतिकूल / हानिकारक, averse = अनिच्छुक / विरुद्ध
meaning_en: adverse = harmful or unfavourable, averse = having a strong dislike or reluctance
example: She was averse to taking risks under adverse weather conditions.

meaning_hi: affect = प्रभावित करना, effect = परिणाम / प्रभाव
meaning_en: affect = to influence (verb), effect = result (noun)
example: Pollution can affect health; its effect on lungs is well documented.

meaning_hi: ail = पीड़ित होना, ale = एक प्रकार की बीयर
meaning_en: ail = to be ill or troubled, ale = a type of alcoholic drink
example: What ails him could be the ale he drank last night.

meaning_hi: air = हवा, heir = उत्तराधिकारी
meaning_en: air = atmosphere, heir = one who inherits
example: The heir breathed the fresh morning air.

meaning_hi: aisle = गलियारा, isle = द्वीप
meaning_en: aisle = a passage between rows, isle = a small island
example: The bride walked down the aisle dreaming of a holiday on a tropical isle.

meaning_hi: allowed = अनुमति दी गई, aloud = जोर से
meaning_en: allowed = permitted, aloud = loudly
example: Students are allowed to read aloud in the library.

meaning_hi: allusion = संकेत / परोक्ष उल्लेख, illusion = भ्रम / भ्रांति
meaning_en: allusion = an indirect reference, illusion = a false impression or deceptive appearance
example: His speech made an allusion to freedom, shattering the illusion of stability.

meaning_hi: altar = वेदी / यज्ञ-वेदी, alter = बदलना
meaning_en: altar = a sacred table in a place of worship, alter = to change
example: The priest refused to alter the ceremony at the altar.

meaning_hi: ant = चींटी, aunt = मौसी / चाची / बुआ
meaning_en: ant = a small insect, aunt = a parent's sister
example: My aunt screamed when she saw an ant on her plate.

meaning_hi: apprise = सूचित करना, appraise = मूल्यांकन करना
meaning_en: apprise = to inform someone of a situation, appraise = to assess the value or quality
example: Please apprise the manager before he appraises the property.

meaning_hi: arc = चाप / वक्र, ark = नाव / पेटी
meaning_en: arc = a curved line, ark = a large boat or chest
example: The rainbow formed a perfect arc above the old wooden ark.

meaning_hi: ascent = चढ़ाई / उन्नति, assent = सहमति
meaning_en: ascent = the act of climbing, assent = agreement
example: With the team's assent, they began their ascent of the mountain.

meaning_hi: ate = खाया, eight = आठ
meaning_en: ate = past tense of eat, eight = the number 8
example: He ate eight mangoes in one sitting.

meaning_hi: ball = गेंद / नृत्य समारोह, bawl = चिल्लाना / रोना
meaning_en: ball = a round object or formal dance, bawl = to cry loudly
example: The child began to bawl when the ball rolled into the drain.

meaning_hi: band = बैंड / समूह / पट्टी, banned = प्रतिबंधित
meaning_en: band = a musical group or strip, banned = officially prohibited
example: The music band was banned from performing in the town.

meaning_hi: bare = नग्न / खुला, bear = भालू / सहन करना
meaning_en: bare = uncovered or empty, bear = animal or to endure
example: The bear walked across the bare hillside.

meaning_hi: baron = सामंत / बड़ा व्यापारी, barren = बंजर
meaning_en: baron = a nobleman or powerful businessman, barren = infertile
example: The oil baron owned vast tracts of barren desert land.

meaning_hi: base = आधार / नीच, bass = बास (संगीत) / एक मछली
meaning_en: base = the bottom or foundation, bass = a low musical note or a type of fish
example: The bass guitarist stood at the base of the stage.

meaning_hi: bazaar = बाजार, bizarre = विचित्र / अजीब
meaning_en: bazaar = a market, bizarre = very strange
example: She found a bizarre necklace in the local bazaar.

meaning_hi: be = होना, bee = मधुमक्खी
meaning_en: be = to exist, bee = stinging insect
example: Let the bee be; it means no harm.

meaning_hi: bean = सेम, been = रहा है (past participle)
meaning_en: bean = a legume seed, been = past participle of 'be'
example: I have been cooking beans since morning.

meaning_hi: berth = शयन स्थान (ट्रेन में), birth = जन्म
meaning_en: berth = a sleeping place on a train or ship, birth = being born
example: He was given an upper berth on the train the day after the child's birth.

meaning_hi: bloc = राजनीतिक गुट, block = ब्लॉक / रुकावट
meaning_en: bloc = a group of countries or parties, block = a solid piece or obstruction
example: The trading bloc imposed a block on foreign imports.

meaning_hi: board = तख्ता / बोर्ड, bored = ऊबा हुआ
meaning_en: board = flat piece of wood or committee, bored = feeling uninterested
example: He felt bored sitting on the wooden board.

meaning_hi: boarder = किराएदार / छात्रावासी, border = सीमा
meaning_en: boarder = a lodger or boarding school student, border = an edge or boundary
example: The boarder lived near the country's northern border.

meaning_hi: braid = चोटी / बुनना, brayed = रेंका (गधे ने)
meaning_en: braid = to weave strands together, brayed = made the sound of a donkey
example: She braided her hair while the donkey brayed outside.

meaning_hi: brake = ब्रेक (रोकने का यंत्र), break = तोड़ना / विराम
meaning_en: brake = device to stop a vehicle, break = to shatter or a pause
example: Press the brake gently so you do not break the speed record.

meaning_hi: breach = उल्लंघन / दरार, breech = पतलून का निचला भाग / बंदूक का पिछला हिस्सा
meaning_en: breach = a gap or violation, breech = the lower part of a garment or gun
example: The security breach was discovered near the breech of the old cannon.

meaning_hi: bridal = विवाह संबंधी, bridle = लगाम / रोकना
meaning_en: bridal = relating to a bride or wedding, bridle = a harness for a horse
example: She wore a bridal veil while adjusting the horse's bridle.

meaning_hi: broach = छेदना / विषय उठाना, brooch = ब्रोच (गहना)
meaning_en: broach = to raise a topic for discussion, brooch = a decorative pin
example: She decided to broach the subject while wearing her grandmother's brooch.

meaning_hi: buoy = बोया (पानी पर तैरता निशान), boy = लड़का
meaning_en: buoy = a floating marker in water, boy = a male child
example: The boy swam towards the orange buoy in the middle of the lake.

meaning_hi: buy = खरीदना, by = द्वारा / पास, bye = अलविदा
meaning_en: buy = to purchase, by = near or through, bye = farewell
example: Buy the ticket, travel by train, and wave bye at the station.

meaning_hi: calendar = पंचांग / कैलेंडर, colander = छलनी
meaning_en: calendar = a chart of dates, colander = a strainer with holes
example: Check the calendar while draining pasta through the colander.

meaning_hi: callous = निर्दयी, callus = कड़ी त्वचा
meaning_en: callous = showing no sympathy, callus = hardened skin
example: The callous manager had a callus on his hand from years of hard work.

meaning_hi: cannon = तोप, canon = नियम / मानक
meaning_en: cannon = a large gun, canon = an accepted rule or standard
example: The novel became part of the literary canon soon after the cannon fell silent.

meaning_hi: canvas = कैनवास (कपड़ा), canvass = प्रचार करना
meaning_en: canvas = a heavy cloth for painting or tents, canvass = to seek votes or opinions
example: The artist stretched his canvas before going out to canvass for votes.

meaning_hi: capital = राजधानी / पूँजी / बड़ा अक्षर, capitol = संसद भवन (अमेरिका में)
meaning_en: capital = a seat of government or money, capitol = the building where a legislature meets
example: The capital city's capitol building was open to tourists.

meaning_hi: cast = फेंकना / अभिनेता-मंडली, caste = जाति
meaning_en: cast = to throw or the actors in a play, caste = a social class
example: The entire cast belonged to a high caste in the drama about social hierarchy.

meaning_hi: cede = सौंप देना / छोड़ देना, seed = बीज
meaning_en: cede = to give up territory or rights, seed = a plant embryo
example: The nation refused to cede its land, vowing to plant every seed with pride.

meaning_hi: ceiling = छत (ऊपरी सतह), sealing = सील करना / बंद करना
meaning_en: ceiling = the top surface of a room, sealing = closing firmly
example: Workers painted the ceiling before sealing the windows against the cold.

meaning_hi: cell = कोषिका / कोठरी, sell = बेचना
meaning_en: cell = small unit or room, sell = to exchange for money
example: He was sent to a prison cell for trying to sell stolen goods.

meaning_hi: cellar = तहखाना, seller = विक्रेता
meaning_en: cellar = an underground room, seller = one who sells
example: The wine seller stored his finest bottles in the cellar.

meaning_hi: cent = सिक्का (100वाँ भाग), scent = सुगंध, sent = भेजा
meaning_en: cent = one hundredth of a dollar, scent = fragrance, sent = past tense of send
example: She sent a bottle of perfume; every cent was worth its scent.

meaning_hi: cereal = अनाज / नाश्ते का अनाज, serial = क्रमिक / धारावाहिक
meaning_en: cereal = grain used as food, serial = arranged in a series or a TV series
example: She watched her favourite serial while eating a bowl of cereal.

meaning_hi: chord = संगीत में स्वर-समूह, cord = रस्सी / डोरी
meaning_en: chord = a combination of musical notes, cord = a thin rope
example: He strummed the opening chord and tied the cord around the guitar case.

meaning_hi: cite = उद्धृत करना, sight = दृश्य / दृष्टि, site = स्थान
meaning_en: cite = to quote as a source, sight = vision or a view, site = a location
example: The journalist will cite the construction site as a historical sight.

meaning_hi: clause = उपवाक्य / धारा, claws = पंजे
meaning_en: clause = a section of a legal document or a grammar unit, claws = sharp curved nails of an animal
example: The contract had a clause about damage caused by a lion's claws.

meaning_hi: climb = चढ़ना, clime = जलवायु / क्षेत्र
meaning_en: climb = to ascend, clime = a region or climate
example: She chose to climb mountains in every clime she visited.

meaning_hi: coarse = खुरदरा / भद्दा, course = पाठ्यक्रम / मार्ग / कोर्स
meaning_en: coarse = rough in texture or manner, course = route or programme of study
example: The course included handling coarse materials like sandpaper.

meaning_hi: colonel = कर्नल (सैन्य अधिकारी), kernel = बीज का भीतरी भाग
meaning_en: colonel = a senior army officer, kernel = the inner part of a nut or seed
example: The colonel cracked open a walnut and ate the kernel.

meaning_hi: complacent = आत्मसंतुष्ट, complaisant = खुशी से सहमत होने वाला
meaning_en: complacent = smugly satisfied, complaisant = eagerly willing to please
example: The complacent manager was too complaisant to challenge bad decisions.

meaning_hi: complement = पूरक (पूर्ण करना), compliment = प्रशंसा
meaning_en: complement = something that completes, compliment = an expression of praise
example: She gave him a compliment on how well his tie complemented his suit.

meaning_hi: continual = बार-बार होने वाला, continuous = लगातार बिना रुके
meaning_en: continual = happening repeatedly with short breaks, continuous = without any interruption
example: The continual rain was unusual; continuous rain for forty days would be a disaster.

meaning_hi: coral = मूँगा, choral = सामूहिक गायन संबंधी
meaning_en: coral = a sea organism or its pinkish colour, choral = relating to a choir
example: The choral group wore coral-coloured robes during the performance.

meaning_hi: council = परिषद / समिति, counsel = सलाह / वकील
meaning_en: council = a governing body, counsel = advice or a lawyer
example: The city council sought legal counsel before approving the new plan.

meaning_hi: cue = संकेत / बिलियर्ड की छड़ी, queue = कतार
meaning_en: cue = a signal or a billiard stick, queue = a line of waiting people
example: On the director's cue, the actor joined the queue for the scene.

meaning_hi: current = धारा / वर्तमान, currant = किशमिश / एक फल
meaning_en: current = a flow of water or air, or present-day, currant = a small dried fruit
example: The current trend is to add currant to baked goods.

meaning_hi: dam = बाँध, damn = शाप देना / बिल्कुल
meaning_en: dam = a barrier holding back water, damn = to condemn or an expletive
example: The engineer built the dam to control the river he privately called damn difficult.

meaning_hi: dear = प्रिय / महंगा, deer = हिरण
meaning_en: dear = beloved or expensive, deer = a hoofed wild animal
example: My dear friend spotted a deer in the forest.

meaning_hi: deprecate = अस्वीकृति व्यक्त करना, depreciate = मूल्य घटना / छोटा दिखाना
meaning_en: deprecate = to express disapproval, depreciate = to lose value over time
example: Critics deprecated the policy, and investors watched the currency depreciate.

meaning_hi: die = मरना, dye = रंग / रंगना
meaning_en: die = to cease living, dye = a colouring substance
example: She used dye to colour the fabric before it could die of age.

meaning_hi: discreet = विवेकशील / सतर्क, discrete = अलग / पृथक
meaning_en: discreet = careful and tactful to avoid causing offence, discrete = individually separate and distinct
example: The discreet official kept the three discrete reports confidential.

meaning_hi: disinterested = निष्पक्ष, uninterested = अरुचि वाला
meaning_en: disinterested = impartial, having no personal stake, uninterested = lacking interest or attention
example: A judge must be disinterested; a student who is uninterested will not pass.

meaning_hi: draft = मसौदा / भर्ती, draught = हवा का झोंका / घूँट
meaning_en: draft = a rough version or conscription, draught = a current of air or a drink
example: He sat in a cold draught while completing the first draft of his report.

meaning_hi: dual = दोहरा, duel = द्वंद्व युद्ध
meaning_en: dual = having two parts, duel = a fight between two people
example: The dual role of referee and judge made it feel like a one-sided duel.

meaning_hi: due = देय / नियत, dew = ओस
meaning_en: due = owed or expected, dew = water droplets on surfaces at dawn
example: The payment is due by morning, when the dew still glistens on the grass.

meaning_hi: earn = कमाना, urn = घड़ा / कलश
meaning_en: earn = to receive money through work, urn = a vase-shaped container
example: He worked hard to earn enough money to buy a decorative urn.

meaning_hi: elicit = प्रकट करना, illicit = अवैध
meaning_en: elicit = to draw out a response, illicit = illegal
example: The officer tried to elicit information about the illicit trade.

meaning_hi: elusive = अपकड़ / पकड़ में न आने वाला, illusive = भ्रामक
meaning_en: elusive = difficult to find or catch, illusive = based on or producing illusion
example: The elusive treasure turned out to be an illusive dream.

meaning_en: emigrant = a person who leaves their own country, immigrant = a person who enters a new country
example: He was an emigrant from India and an immigrant to Canada.

meaning_hi: emigrate = देश छोड़ना, immigrate = देश में आना
meaning_en: emigrate = to leave one's country, immigrate = to enter a new country
example: Many families emigrate from their homeland to immigrate to wealthier nations.

meaning_hi: eminent = विशिष्ट / प्रतिष्ठित, imminent = आसन्न / जल्द होने वाला
meaning_en: eminent = famous and respected in a particular field, imminent = about to happen very soon
example: An eminent scientist warned that a major earthquake was imminent.

meaning_hi: envelop = ढकना / घेरना, envelope = लिफाफा
meaning_en: envelop = to surround or wrap, envelope = a paper cover for a letter
example: Darkness began to envelop the city as she sealed the envelope.

meaning_hi: eve = पूर्व संध्या, eave = छज्जा
meaning_en: eve = the evening before an event, eave = the overhanging edge of a roof
example: On the eve of the festival, birds nested under the eave of the house.

meaning_hi: eye = आँख, I = मैं
meaning_en: eye = organ of sight, I = first person singular pronoun
example: I see with my eye what others tend to overlook.

meaning_hi: faint = बेहोश होना / हल्का, feint = छलावा / झूठा हमला
meaning_en: faint = to lose consciousness or barely visible, feint = a deceptive move
example: His faint smile was a feint designed to mislead the opponent.

meaning_hi: fair = न्यायसंगत / मेला / गोरा, fare = किराया / भोजन
meaning_en: fair = just, or an exhibition, or light-complexioned, fare = travel cost or food
example: The bus fare to reach the fair was quite reasonable.

meaning_hi: fate = भाग्य, fete = उत्सव / सम्मानित करना
meaning_en: fate = destiny, fete = a festival or to honour someone publicly
example: It seemed like fate that the village fete was held on his birthday.

meaning_hi: feat = कारनामा / उपलब्धि, feet = पैर (बहुवचन)
meaning_en: feat = a remarkable achievement, feet = plural of foot
example: Climbing that peak barefoot was a feat accomplished on his own two feet.

meaning_hi: find = खोजना / पाना, fined = जुर्माना लगाया गया
meaning_en: find = to discover, fined = penalised with a fine
example: He was fined for parking illegally, only to find a fifty-rupee note on the ground.

meaning_hi: flair = प्रतिभा / विशेषता, flare = भड़कना / चमकना
meaning_en: flair = a natural talent, flare = a sudden burst of flame or light
example: She had a flair for design and created a beautiful flare-sleeved dress.

meaning_hi: flaw = दोष / खामी, floor = फर्श
meaning_en: flaw = an imperfection, floor = the ground surface of a room
example: The only flaw in the design was a crack visible on the floor.

meaning_hi: flea = पिस्सू, flee = भागना
meaning_en: flea = a small blood-sucking insect, flee = to run away from danger
example: The dog tried to flee from the veterinarian who was removing its flea.

meaning_hi: flew = उड़ा, flu = इन्फ्लूएंजा, flue = चिमनी की नली
meaning_en: flew = past tense of fly, flu = influenza, flue = a pipe for smoke
example: The bird flew past the flue while the family recovered from the flu.

meaning_hi: flounder = संघर्ष करना / लड़खड़ाना, founder = डूबना / संस्थापक
meaning_en: flounder = to struggle helplessly, founder = to fail or sink, or one who establishes something
example: The startup began to flounder and then founder within a year.

meaning_hi: flour = आटा, flower = फूल
meaning_en: flour = finely ground grain used in cooking, flower = the blossom of a plant
example: She kept a fresh flower beside the bag of flour in the kitchen.

meaning_hi: for = के लिए, four = चार
meaning_en: for = on behalf of or in exchange for, four = the number 4
example: This reward is for the four students who won first place.

meaning_hi: forth = आगे, fourth = चौथा
meaning_en: forth = forward or out, fourth = ordinal of four
example: She marched forth from the fourth floor without looking back.

meaning_hi: foul = गंदा / अनुचित, fowl = मुर्गी / पक्षी
meaning_en: foul = unpleasant or against the rules, fowl = a domestic bird
example: The fowl made a foul smell inside the closed room.

meaning_hi: franc = फ्रेंच मुद्रा, frank = स्पष्ट / खुलकर बोलने वाला
meaning_en: franc = a French currency unit, frank = honest and direct in speech
example: He was frank about not having a single franc in his pocket.

meaning_hi: gate = द्वार / फाटक, gait = चाल / चलने का तरीका
meaning_en: gate = a hinged barrier at an entrance, gait = a manner of walking
example: The soldier's confident gait caught everyone's attention at the gate.

meaning_hi: genes = जीन (आनुवंशिकी), jeans = जींस पतलून
meaning_en: genes = biological units of heredity, jeans = denim trousers
example: His genes gave him long legs that made his jeans always too short.

meaning_hi: gilt = सोने की परत चढ़ाना, guilt = अपराध-बोध
meaning_en: gilt = covered with gold, guilt = a feeling of having done wrong
example: The gilt frame was purchased to cover the artist's guilt over selling a copy.

meaning_hi: gorilla = गोरिल्ला (वानर), guerrilla = छापामार सैनिक
meaning_en: gorilla = a large ape, guerrilla = a fighter using surprise attacks
example: The documentary compared gorilla tactics to guerrilla warfare.

meaning_hi: grade = श्रेणी / दर्जा, grayed = धूसर हो गया
meaning_en: grade = a level or mark, grayed = became grey
example: His hair grayed quickly after receiving the lowest grade in the exam.

meaning_hi: grate = कद्दूकस करना / चिढ़ाना, great = महान / बहुत अच्छा
meaning_en: grate = to shred or to irritate, great = of outstanding quality
example: Great chefs know how to grate cheese without irritating anyone.

meaning_hi: grisly = भयावह / रोंगटे खड़े करने वाला, grizzly = भूरे रंग का भालू / धूसर
meaning_en: grisly = causing horror or disgust, grizzly = a type of large brown bear or grey-haired
example: The explorer had a grisly encounter with a grizzly bear in the forest.

meaning_hi: groan = कराहना, grown = बड़ा हुआ
meaning_en: groan = a deep sound of pain, grown = past participle of 'grow'
example: The grown man let out a groan when he stubbed his toe.

meaning_hi: guest = मेहमान, guessed = अनुमान लगाया
meaning_en: guest = a visitor, guessed = past tense of guess
example: The guest correctly guessed the theme of the event.

meaning_hi: guise = वेश / बहाना, guys = लोग (अनौपचारिक)
meaning_en: guise = an outward appearance, guys = people informally
example: In the guise of helpers, the guys were actually investigating the case.

meaning_hi: hail = ओले / अभिवादन करना, hale = स्वस्थ / खींचना
meaning_en: hail = frozen rain or to greet, hale = strong and healthy or to drag
example: The hale old man stood in the hail without a coat.

meaning_hi: hair = बाल, hare = खरगोश (जंगली)
meaning_en: hair = strands growing from the scalp, hare = a fast wild animal like a large rabbit
example: The hare had unusually smooth hair on its coat.

meaning_hi: hall = हॉल / गलियारा, haul = ढोना / खींचना
meaning_en: hall = a large room or corridor, haul = to pull with effort
example: Workers had to haul the heavy equipment through the main hall.

meaning_hi: hanger = कपड़े टाँगने का हुक, hangar = हवाई जहाज़ का शेड
meaning_en: hanger = a frame for hanging clothes, hangar = a large shed for aircraft
example: He left his coat on a hanger inside the airline hangar.

meaning_hi: hart = नर हिरण (वयस्क), heart = हृदय
meaning_en: hart = a male deer over five years old, heart = the cardiac organ
example: The hunter's heart raced when he spotted the magnificent hart.

meaning_hi: heal = ठीक करना, heel = एड़ी
meaning_en: heal = to recover or cure, heel = the back part of the foot
example: The blister on his heel took two weeks to heal completely.

meaning_hi: hear = सुनना, here = यहाँ
meaning_en: hear = to perceive sound, here = at this place
example: Come here so I can hear what you are saying.

meaning_hi: him = उसे (pronoun), hymn = भजन / स्तुति गीत
meaning_en: him = object pronoun for a male, hymn = a song of praise to God
example: The choir sang a hymn in memory of him.

meaning_hi: hoard = भंडार जमा करना, horde = भीड़
meaning_en: hoard = to accumulate secretly, horde = a large disorganised crowd
example: A horde of people discovered his hoard of old coins.

meaning_hi: hoarse = कर्कश / भर्राई आवाज़, horse = घोड़ा
meaning_en: hoarse = rough and harsh in voice, horse = an equine animal
example: His voice became hoarse after shouting at the horse race for hours.

meaning_hi: hole = छेद / गड्ढा, whole = पूरा / संपूर्ण
meaning_en: hole = an opening or gap, whole = complete, entire
example: The whole fence had a hole in the middle section.

meaning_hi: hour = घंटा, our = हमारा
meaning_en: hour = a period of sixty minutes, our = belonging to us
example: Our meeting is scheduled to begin in an hour.

meaning_hi: idle = निष्क्रिय / आलसी, idol = मूर्ति / आदर्श व्यक्ति
meaning_en: idle = not active or lazy, idol = an object of worship or great admiration
example: He sat idle all day worshipping his idol.

meaning_hi: impassable = अगम्य, impassible = संवेदनाहीन
meaning_en: impassable = impossible to travel through, impassible = incapable of feeling
example: The impassible general crossed the terrain others called impassable.

meaning_hi: in = अंदर / में, inn = सराय / छोटा होटल
meaning_en: in = inside or within, inn = a small hotel
example: We stayed in a cosy inn on the way to the hills.

meaning_hi: incite = उकसाना, insight = अंतर्दृष्टि
meaning_en: incite = to provoke, insight = understanding
example: His speech was meant to incite action, but it gave people surprising insight.

meaning_hi: jam = जैम / जाम, jamb = दरवाजे की चौखट
meaning_en: jam = a fruit preserve or traffic block, jamb = the side post of a door frame
example: The door jamb was sticky from the jam that had spilled onto it.

meaning_hi: judicial = न्यायिक / अदालत संबंधी, judicious = विवेकपूर्ण / सुविचारित
meaning_en: judicial = relating to courts and the administration of justice, judicious = having sound judgement
example: A judicious use of judicial authority inspires public trust.

meaning_hi: knave = धूर्त / चालाक व्यक्ति, nave = मध्य गलियारा (गिरजे का)
meaning_en: knave = a dishonest or cunning person, nave = the central part of a church
example: The knave was caught stealing candles from the nave of the cathedral.

meaning_hi: kneel = घुटने टेकना, Neil = नाम
meaning_en: kneel = to go down on one knee, Neil = a proper name
example: Neil had to kneel before the ceremony could begin.

meaning_hi: knew = जानता था (past of know), new = नया
meaning_en: knew = past tense of know, new = not existing before
example: He knew about the new scheme before anyone else.

meaning_hi: knight = शूरवीर, night = रात
meaning_en: knight = a medieval warrior or chess piece, night = the period of darkness
example: The brave knight returned to the castle late at night.

meaning_hi: knit = बुनना, nit = लीख (जूँ का अंडा)
meaning_en: knit = to make fabric from yarn, nit = the egg of a louse
example: She would knit hats to help children suffering from nit infestations.

meaning_hi: knot = गाँठ, not = नहीं
meaning_en: knot = a fastening made by tying rope, not = a negative word
example: This is knot the solution — the knot is still tied on the wrong end.

meaning_hi: know = जानना, no = नहीं
meaning_en: know = to have knowledge of, no = a negative reply
example: I know the answer is no, but I still had to try.

meaning_hi: lain = लेटा हुआ (past participle of lie), lane = गली / लेन
meaning_en: lain = past participle of 'lie' (to recline), lane = a narrow road or division
example: He had lain on the grass beside the quiet country lane all afternoon.

meaning_hi: lax = ढीला / लापरवाह, lacks = कमी है
meaning_en: lax = not strict, lacks = does not have
example: The system lacks proper checks because the management is too lax.

meaning_hi: lea = घास का मैदान, lee = हवा से बचाव की जगह
meaning_en: lea = an open meadow, lee = the sheltered side away from wind
example: The shepherd rested in the lee of the hill overlooking the open lea.

meaning_hi: leased = पट्टे पर दिया, least = कम से कम
meaning_en: leased = given on lease, least = the smallest degree
example: At the very least, the property should have been leased for three years.

meaning_hi: lessen = कम करना, lesson = पाठ / सबक
meaning_en: lessen = to reduce in amount, lesson = a period of learning
example: Every lesson learnt in life helps lessen future mistakes.

meaning_hi: levy = कर / उगाही, levee = तटबंध
meaning_en: levy = a tax or charge, levee = an embankment to prevent flooding
example: The government imposed a levy to fund the construction of a new levee.

meaning_hi: licence = अनुमति-पत्र (noun), license = अनुमति देना (verb)
meaning_en: licence = a permit (noun), license = to give official permission (verb)
example: The authority will license the shop once they check the licence documents.

meaning_hi: literal = शाब्दिक, littoral = तटीय
meaning_en: literal = taking words in their exact meaning, littoral = relating to the shore
example: His literal interpretation of the map led them directly to the littoral region.

meaning_hi: loan = ऋण / उधार, lone = अकेला
meaning_en: loan = money borrowed, lone = solitary, alone
example: The lone businessman took out a loan to start his new venture.

meaning_hi: loath = अनिच्छुक / अनमना, loathe = घृणा करना
meaning_en: loath = reluctant or unwilling (adjective), loathe = to feel intense dislike for (verb)
example: He was loath to admit that he loathed the idea from the start.

meaning_hi: luxuriant = घना / भरपूर, luxurious = विलासपूर्ण / आरामदायक
meaning_en: luxuriant = lush, rich and abundant in growth, luxurious = characterised by luxury and comfort
example: The luxurious resort was surrounded by luxuriant tropical vegetation.

meaning_hi: made = बनाया / बना हुआ, maid = नौकरानी / कुमारी
meaning_en: made = past tense of make, maid = a female servant
example: The maid made the bed before the guests arrived.

meaning_hi: mail = डाक / ईमेल, male = पुरुष / नर
meaning_en: mail = letters and parcels, male = of the masculine gender
example: The male postman delivered the morning mail on time.

meaning_hi: main = मुख्य / प्रधान, mane = अयाल (शेर/घोड़े के बाल)
meaning_en: main = most important, mane = long hair on a lion's or horse's neck
example: The lion's flowing mane was its main distinguishing feature.

meaning_hi: manor = जागीर / बड़ा घर, manner = तरीका / व्यवहार
meaning_en: manor = a large country house with land, manner = a way of behaving
example: The lord of the manor had a polite and dignified manner.

meaning_hi: mare = घोड़ी, mayor = महापौर
meaning_en: mare = a female horse, mayor = the elected head of a city
example: The mayor rode a white mare through the town square on Republic Day.

meaning_hi: marshal = मार्शल / सजाना, martial = युद्ध संबंधी
meaning_en: marshal = to organise or a high official, martial = relating to war
example: The marshal arranged the troops in the order required by martial law.

meaning_hi: meat = मांस, meet = मिलना
meaning_en: meat = the flesh of animals used as food, meet = to come together
example: Let us meet at the market after buying the meat.

meaning_hi: medal = पदक / तमगा, meddle = दखलअंदाजी करना
meaning_en: medal = an award for achievement, meddle = to interfere in others' affairs
example: She won a gold medal because she never let others meddle in her training.

meaning_hi: mews = अस्तबल के पास की सड़क, muse = प्रेरणा देना / सोचना
meaning_en: mews = a row of houses converted from stables, muse = to think or a source of inspiration
example: She would muse on her next poem while walking through the cobbled mews.

meaning_hi: might = शक्ति / संभव, mite = घुन / छोटा बच्चा
meaning_en: might = power or possibility, mite = a tiny insect or a small amount
example: With all his might, he defeated even the tiniest mite of doubt.

meaning_hi: miner = खान मजदूर, minor = नाबालिग / छोटा
meaning_en: miner = a person who works in a mine, minor = a person below legal age or something small
example: The minor was not allowed to work as a miner under the law.

meaning_hi: missed = चूक गया / याद किया, mist = धुंध
meaning_en: missed = past tense of miss, mist = a thin fog
example: He missed the morning train because he could not see through the thick mist.

meaning_hi: moan = कराहना / शिकायत करना, mown = घास काटी हुई
meaning_en: moan = to make a low sound of pain, mown = past participle of mow
example: He let out a moan of relief when he saw the freshly mown lawn.

meaning_hi: moose = एल्क (उत्तरी अमेरिकी हिरण), mousse = मूस (एक मिठाई/झाग)
meaning_en: moose = a large North American deer, mousse = a light whipped dessert or hair product
example: The chef prepared chocolate mousse after spotting a moose near the camp.

meaning_hi: morning = सुबह, mourning = शोक / मातम
meaning_en: morning = the early part of the day, mourning = grief after a death
example: The entire family was in mourning early on Monday morning.

meaning_hi: muscle = मांसपेशी, mussel = एक समुद्री शंख
meaning_en: muscle = body tissue that contracts, mussel = an edible shellfish
example: He used every muscle to pull the fishing net full of mussels ashore.

meaning_hi: naval = नौसेना संबंधी, navel = नाभि
meaning_en: naval = relating to a navy, navel = the belly button
example: The naval officer had a tattoo near his navel.

meaning_hi: nay = नहीं (पुराना), neigh = हिनहिनाना
meaning_en: nay = an old word for no, neigh = the sound a horse makes
example: The horse let out a loud neigh when the rider said nay to a longer ride.

meaning_hi: need = जरूरत, knead = गूँधना
meaning_en: need = a requirement, knead = to press and work dough
example: You need to knead the dough well before baking the bread.

meaning_hi: none = कोई नहीं, nun = साध्वी / नन
meaning_en: none = not any, nun = a woman living in a religious order
example: None of the nuns was present when the ceremony began.

meaning_hi: oar = चप्पू, ore = अयस्क (खनिज)
meaning_en: oar = a pole used to row a boat, ore = a mineral containing metal
example: He used the oar to reach the island rich in iron ore.

meaning_hi: ode = ओड (एक काव्य प्रकार), owed = बकाया था / देनदारी
meaning_en: ode = a lyric poem, owed = past tense of owe
example: He wrote an ode to the friend to whom he owed so much gratitude.

meaning_hi: oh = ओह! (विस्मय), owe = देना होना / कर्जदार होना
meaning_en: oh = an exclamation of surprise, owe = to be indebted
example: Oh! I forgot that I owe you twenty rupees.

meaning_hi: one = एक, won = जीता
meaning_en: one = the number 1, won = past tense of win
example: One determined athlete won all three gold medals.

meaning_hi: oral = मौखिक / मुँह से, aural = कान संबंधी / श्रवण
meaning_en: oral = spoken by mouth, aural = relating to the ear or hearing
example: The exam had both an oral and an aural comprehension section.

meaning_hi: overdo = अत्यधिक करना, overdue = विलंबित / बकाया
meaning_en: overdo = to do too much, overdue = late or past the due date
example: Do not overdo the exercise; your medical report is already overdue.

meaning_hi: packed = भरा हुआ / पैक किया, pact = समझौता / संधि
meaning_en: packed = filled tightly, pact = an agreement
example: The delegates signed a pact in a room packed with journalists.

meaning_hi: pain = दर्द / पीड़ा, pane = शीशे का टुकड़ा
meaning_en: pain = physical or emotional suffering, pane = a sheet of glass in a window
example: He winced in pain after accidentally cracking the window pane.

meaning_hi: pair = जोड़ी, pear = नाशपाती
meaning_en: pair = a set of two matching things, pear = a sweet juicy fruit
example: She packed a pair of sandwiches and a ripe pear for lunch.

meaning_hi: palate = तालू / स्वाद, palette = रंग-पटल, pallet = लकड़ी का चौकोर तख्ता
meaning_en: palate = the roof of the mouth, palette = an artist's colour board, pallet = a wooden platform
example: The artist's sensitive palate inspired the colours on his palette, displayed on a wooden pallet.

meaning_hi: pare = छीलना, pear = नाशपाती, pair = जोड़ी
meaning_en: pare = to peel, pear = a fruit, pair = a set of two
example: She used a pair of knives to pare the skin from the pear.

meaning_hi: passed = गुजरा / उत्तीर्ण हुआ, past = अतीत / किसी स्थान के आगे
meaning_en: passed = moved beyond or succeeded, past = gone by, or beyond a point
example: She passed the school in her car and sped past the old building.

meaning_hi: patience = धैर्य, patients = मरीज (बहुवचन)
meaning_en: patience = the ability to wait calmly, patients = plural of patient (sick persons)
example: A good doctor has patience while attending to all his patients.

meaning_hi: peace = शांति, piece = टुकड़ा
meaning_en: peace = freedom from disturbance, piece = a portion or part
example: She ate a piece of cake in perfect peace after the long journey.

meaning_hi: pedal = पैडल चलाना, peddle = बेचना / फेरी लगाना
meaning_en: pedal = to operate with the feet, peddle = to sell from place to place
example: He would pedal his bicycle to peddle vegetables in the market.

meaning_hi: peer = समकक्ष / टकटकी लगाना, pier = घाट / जेटी
meaning_en: peer = an equal or to look closely, pier = a structure extending into water
example: He had to peer through the fog to find the wooden pier.

meaning_hi: persecute = उत्पीड़ित करना, prosecute = मुकदमा चलाना
meaning_en: persecute = to treat someone cruelly on the basis of race or beliefs, prosecute = to take legal action
example: The state chose to prosecute those who persecute religious minorities.

meaning_hi: petal = पंखुड़ी, pedal = पैडल
meaning_en: petal = a flower part, pedal = a foot-operated lever
example: The child pressed the pedal gently, scattering petals on the path.

meaning_hi: phase = चरण / अवस्था, faze = विचलित करना
meaning_en: phase = a stage of development, faze = to disturb or disconcert
example: This phase of the project did not faze the experienced team.

meaning_hi: phial = छोटी दवाई की शीशी, file = फाइल / रेती
meaning_en: phial = a small glass bottle, file = a folder or a tool for smoothing
example: The chemist placed the phial beside the patient's file.

meaning_hi: plain = साधारण / मैदान, plane = विमान / समतल
meaning_en: plain = simple or a flat area of land, plane = aircraft or flat surface
example: The plane descended slowly over the vast open plain below.

meaning_hi: plait = चोटी (बालों की), plate = थाली / प्लेट
meaning_en: plait = braided hair, plate = a flat dish
example: She wore her hair in a plait and ate from the best china plate.

meaning_hi: plum = आलूबुखारा, plumb = सीधा नापना / बिल्कुल
meaning_en: plum = a purple fruit, plumb = to measure depth or exactly vertical
example: The builder used a plumb line and rewarded himself with a plum.

meaning_hi: pole = खंभा / ध्रुव, poll = मतदान / सर्वेक्षण
meaning_en: pole = a long stick or geographic pole, poll = a vote or survey
example: The exit poll showed voters near the North Pole preferred greener policies.

meaning_hi: pore = रोमछिद्र / ध्यान से पढ़ना, pour = उड़ेलना / डालना
meaning_en: pore = a tiny opening in skin, or to study intently, pour = to flow steadily
example: She would pour tea while continuing to pore over her notes.

meaning_hi: practical = व्यावहारिक / उपयोगी, practicable = क्रियान्वयन योग्य
meaning_en: practical = useful and realistic rather than theoretical, practicable = capable of being put into practice
example: The idea was practical in theory but not practicable given the budget.

meaning_hi: practice = अभ्यास (noun), practise = अभ्यास करना (verb)
meaning_en: practice = the noun form, practise = the verb form
example: Regular practice helps you practise without losing focus.

meaning_hi: pray = प्रार्थना करना, prey = शिकार
meaning_en: pray = to offer a prayer, prey = an animal hunted for food
example: Hunters pray for good weather before going out to find their prey.

meaning_hi: presence = उपस्थिति, presents = उपहार / प्रस्तुत करता है
meaning_en: presence = being present, presents = gifts or the act of presenting
example: The presence of so many guests made distributing the presents difficult.

meaning_hi: principal = प्रधानाचार्य / मुख्य, principle = सिद्धांत
meaning_en: principal = chief or head of a school, principle = a fundamental rule or belief
example: The principal reminded students of the school's core principle of honesty.

meaning_hi: profit = लाभ / मुनाफा, prophet = पैगम्बर / भविष्यवक्ता
meaning_en: profit = financial gain, prophet = one who predicts the future
example: The prophet warned that excessive profit without ethics would ruin society.

meaning_hi: proscribe = निषेध करना / प्रतिबंध लगाना, prescribe = निर्धारित करना / दवाई लिखना
meaning_en: proscribe = to officially forbid, prescribe = to recommend or order as a rule
example: The government will proscribe the drug that doctors used to prescribe.

meaning_hi: pry = ताकझाँक करना / कुरेदना, prey = शिकार
meaning_en: pry = to inquire too closely, prey = an animal hunted for food
example: Reporters would pry into the life of the prey of the corporate scandal.

meaning_hi: quay = घाट / जेटी, key = चाबी / कुंजी
meaning_en: quay = a platform beside water for loading ships, key = a device for opening locks
example: He found the key to the warehouse lying on the quay.

meaning_hi: rack = रैक / पीड़ित करना, wrack = बर्बाद करना / समुद्री घास
meaning_en: rack = a framework or to torment, wrack = destruction
example: The disease went to rack and wrack, ruining everything in its path.

meaning_hi: rain = वर्षा, reign = शासनकाल, rein = लगाम
meaning_en: rain = precipitation from clouds, reign = period of rule, rein = strap to control a horse
example: Heavy rain fell throughout the king's long reign as he pulled on his horse's rein.

meaning_hi: rap = थपथपाना / रैप, wrap = लपेटना
meaning_en: rap = to knock or hip-hop music, wrap = to cover
example: He heard a rap on the door while trying to wrap the gift.

meaning_hi: rapt = मंत्रमुग्ध, wrapped = लपेटा हुआ
meaning_en: rapt = completely absorbed, wrapped = enclosed in covering
example: She sat rapt in thought, a scarf wrapped tightly around her shoulders.

meaning_hi: raze = जमींदोज करना, raise = उठाना
meaning_en: raze = to demolish completely, raise = to lift up
example: The council decided to raise awareness before they raze the old structure.

meaning_hi: read = पढ़ना (वर्तमान काल), reed = सरकंडा / नरकट
meaning_en: read (present tense, /riːd/) = to look at written words, reed = a tall water plant
example: She likes to read poetry while sitting among the reeds by the river.

meaning_hi: real = वास्तविक, reel = चरखी / लड़खड़ाना
meaning_en: real = genuine or actual, reel = a cylinder or to stagger
example: The real shock made him reel back in disbelief.

meaning_hi: reek = बदबू आना, wreak = तबाही मचाना
meaning_en: reek = to smell strongly, wreak = to cause great damage
example: The factory would reek of chemicals and wreak havoc on the environment.

meaning_hi: review = समीक्षा / जाँच, revue = मनोरंजन कार्यक्रम
meaning_en: review = a critical evaluation, revue = a theatrical show with sketches
example: The film review praised the music, which was later performed in a revue.

meaning_hi: right = सही / दायाँ, write = लिखना
meaning_en: right = correct or the direction, write = to form words on a surface
example: Write the right answer on the left side of the paper.

meaning_hi: ring = अंगूठी / घंटी बजाना, wring = मरोड़ना / निचोड़ना
meaning_en: ring = a circular band or to sound a bell, wring = to twist forcefully
example: She would wring the wet cloth and then hang her ring on the hook.

meaning_hi: road = सड़क, rowed = चप्पू चलाया
meaning_en: road = a path for vehicles, rowed = past tense of row
example: He rowed the boat along the road-side canal at dusk.

meaning_hi: roe = मछली के अंडे, row = झगड़ा / कतार / चप्पू चलाना
meaning_en: roe = fish eggs, row = a line or a quarrel or to paddle
example: The fisherman found roe in the nets after a row with his partner.

meaning_hi: role = भूमिका, roll = लुढ़कना / रोल (रोटी)
meaning_en: role = a part played by someone, roll = to move by turning, or a bread roll
example: She played the role of a baker who would roll dough all day.

meaning_hi: root = जड़, route = मार्ग / रास्ता
meaning_en: root = the underground part of a plant, route = a path from one place to another
example: The delivery van took a route that passed near the root of the old banyan tree.

meaning_hi: sac = थैली (जीव विज्ञान), sack = बोरा / बर्खास्त करना
meaning_en: sac = a pouch in biology, sack = a bag or to dismiss from a job
example: The sac inside the body was as tough as the burlap sack.

meaning_hi: sail = पाल / नाव चलाना, sale = बिक्री
meaning_en: sail = a cloth sheet to catch wind for a boat, or to travel by sea, sale = the act of selling
example: He went to the sale to buy a model boat with a sail.

meaning_hi: sane = समझदार / विवेकशील, seine = मछली पकड़ने का जाल
meaning_en: sane = mentally healthy, seine = a type of fishing net
example: Only a sane fisherman knows how to set a seine in the right current.

meaning_hi: scene = दृश्य / जगह, seen = देखा गया
meaning_en: scene = a view or location, seen = past participle of see
example: The police had seen the scene of the crime before anyone else arrived.

meaning_hi: seam = सिलाई की रेखा, seem = लगना / प्रतीत होना
meaning_en: seam = the line where two pieces of fabric are sewn, seem = to appear to be
example: It does not seem possible that the seam could have torn so quickly.

meaning_hi: sensual = कामुक / शारीरिक सुख संबंधी, sensuous = इंद्रियों को सुखद
meaning_en: sensual = relating to physical pleasure, sensuous = affecting or appealing to the senses pleasantly
example: The poem's sensuous imagery contrasted with its sensual undertones.

meaning_hi: shear = कतरना, sheer = बिल्कुल / पतला
meaning_en: shear = to cut hair or wool, sheer = absolute or very thin
example: It was sheer determination that helped him shear the entire flock in a day.

meaning_hi: shoe = जूता, shoo = भगाना
meaning_en: shoe = footwear, shoo = to drive away with a gesture
example: She had to shoo away the dog before putting on her shoe.

meaning_hi: sighs = आहें, size = आकार
meaning_en: sighs = long deep breaths expressing emotion, size = dimensions
example: His sighs were of a size that filled the entire silent room.

meaning_hi: sink = डूबना / बेसिन, sync = समकालिक / तालमेल
meaning_en: sink = to go below the surface, sync = to synchronise
example: Their plans began to sink when they failed to stay in sync.

meaning_hi: sleigh = स्लेज / बर्फ की गाड़ी, slay = मार डालना
meaning_en: sleigh = a vehicle on runners for snow, slay = to kill
example: The knight rode a sleigh in winter, able to slay enemies in any terrain.

meaning_hi: soar = ऊँचा उड़ना, sore = दर्दनाक / घाव
meaning_en: soar = to fly high, sore = painful
example: Her spirits began to soar despite a sore knee.

meaning_hi: sole = एकमात्र / तलवा, soul = आत्मा
meaning_en: sole = only, or the bottom of a shoe, soul = the spiritual part of a person
example: She was the sole survivor, and the experience shook her very soul.

meaning_hi: some = कुछ / कुछ लोग, sum = राशि / जोड़
meaning_en: some = an unspecified amount, sum = a total
example: Give me some time to calculate the entire sum.

meaning_hi: son = पुत्र, sun = सूर्य
meaning_en: son = a male child, sun = the star at the centre of our solar system
example: Every morning, the farmer's son would rise with the sun to tend the fields.

meaning_hi: sow = बीज बोना / सूअरी, so = इसलिए, sew = सिलना
meaning_en: sow = to plant seeds, so = therefore, sew = to stitch
example: She wanted to sow seeds and sew a garden patch, so she woke up early.

meaning_hi: stair = सीढ़ी, stare = घूरना
meaning_en: stair = a step in a flight of steps, stare = to look fixedly
example: She could not help but stare at the steep stair leading to the old tower.

meaning_hi: stake = दाँव / खूँटा, steak = गोमांस / मोटा टुकड़ा
meaning_en: stake = a pointed post or a bet, steak = a thick slice of meat
example: He had a real stake in the restaurant that served the best steak in town.

meaning_hi: statesmen = राजनेता (plural), statesman = राजनेता (singular)
meaning_en: statesman = a skilled political leader, statesmen = plural form
example: The statesmen gathered to honour the great statesman who had served the nation.

meaning_hi: stationary = स्थिर / न हिलने वाला, stationery = लेखन सामग्री
meaning_en: stationary = not moving, stationery = writing materials like pens and paper
example: The stationary van was filled with boxes of stationery for the school.

meaning_hi: steal = चुराना, steel = इस्पात / फौलाद
meaning_en: steal = to take without permission, steel = a hard metal alloy
example: The thief tried to steal tools made of steel from the factory.

meaning_hi: story = कहानी, storey = मंज़िल (इमारत की)
meaning_en: story = a narrative, storey = a floor of a building
example: She wrote a story set on the top storey of a Victorian mansion.

meaning_hi: straight = सीधा, strait = जलडमरूमध्य / तंग
meaning_en: straight = not curved, strait = a narrow body of water
example: The ship sailed in a straight line through the narrow strait.

meaning_hi: suite = कमरों का समूह / सुइट, sweet = मीठा / मिठाई
meaning_en: suite = a set of rooms or musical pieces, sweet = pleasant to taste
example: The honeymoon suite had a basket of sweets on the table.

meaning_hi: tail = पूँछ, tale = कहानी / कथा
meaning_en: tail = the rear appendage of an animal, tale = a story
example: The fox wagged its bushy tail as if telling a tale.

meaning_hi: taught = सिखाया, taut = कसा हुआ / तना हुआ
meaning_en: taught = past tense of teach, taut = pulled tight
example: She taught the students how to keep the rope taut while sailing.

meaning_hi: team = टीम / दल, teem = भरपूर होना / उफनना
meaning_en: team = a group of players, teem = to swarm with
example: The team had to work in a swamp that would teem with insects at dusk.

meaning_hi: tear = आँसू / फाड़ना, tier = स्तर / पंक्ति
meaning_en: tear = a drop from the eye or to rip, tier = a row or level
example: She shed a tear sitting in the top tier of the stadium.

meaning_hi: tern = समुद्री पक्षी, turn = मुड़ना / बारी
meaning_en: tern = a seabird, turn = to rotate or a chance
example: At every turn of the coastal road, we spotted a tern diving for fish.

meaning_hi: thee = तुम्हें (पुराना), the = निश्चित article
meaning_en: thee = old form of 'you', the = definite article
example: The old poem addressed thee in a way the modern reader finds unusual.

meaning_hi: their = उनका, there = वहाँ, they're = वे हैं
meaning_en: their = belonging to them, there = at that place, they're = contraction of they are
example: They're going there in their new car.

meaning_hi: threw = फेंका, through = के माध्यम से / आर-पार
meaning_en: threw = past tense of throw, through = from one side to the other
example: She threw the ball through the narrow gap in the fence.

meaning_hi: throne = सिंहासन, thrown = फेंका गया
meaning_en: throne = a royal seat, thrown = past participle of throw
example: The king was thrown off his throne by a revolt.

meaning_hi: thyme = अजवायन की पत्ती, time = समय
meaning_en: thyme = an aromatic herb, time = the measure of duration
example: There is never enough time to add fresh thyme to every dish.

meaning_hi: tide = ज्वार-भाटा, tied = बँधा हुआ
meaning_en: tide = the rise and fall of the sea, tied = fastened with a knot
example: The boat was tied securely to the dock before the high tide came in.

meaning_hi: tire = थकना / टायर (American), tyre = टायर (British)
meaning_en: tire = to become weary or a rubber ring (American), tyre = a rubber ring (British English)
example: He began to tire after changing the flat tyre on the highway.

meaning_hi: to = को / तक, too = भी / बहुत अधिक, two = दो
meaning_en: to = expressing direction, too = also or excessively, two = the number 2
example: The two of us went to the market; she bought flowers too.

meaning_hi: toad = मेंढक / मेंढकी (भूमि पर रहने वाली), towed = खींचा गया
meaning_en: toad = a land amphibian, towed = pulled along
example: The car was towed away just as a toad hopped across the road.

meaning_hi: toe = पैर की अंगुली, tow = खींचना
meaning_en: toe = a digit on the foot, tow = to pull a vehicle
example: He stubbed his toe on the rope used to tow the boat.

meaning_hi: told = बताया, tolled = घंटा बजाया
meaning_en: told = past tense of tell, tolled = past tense of toll (rang a bell)
example: He told everyone that the church bell had tolled twelve times.

meaning_hi: troop = सैनिक दल, troupe = नाटक-मंडली
meaning_en: troop = a group of soldiers, troupe = a group of performers
example: A troop of soldiers accompanied the theatre troupe to the border town.

meaning_hi: udder = थन (गाय का), utter = बोलना / पूर्ण
meaning_en: udder = the milk organ of a cow, utter = to speak or complete
example: He could not utter a word when the cow's udder was found injured.

meaning_hi: undermine = कमजोर करना, under mine = मेरे नीचे
meaning_en: undermine = to weaken secretly, under mine = beneath something I own
example: He tried to undermine her authority, but the decision was under mine alone.

meaning_hi: urban = शहरी / नगरीय, urbane = शिष्ट / सुसंस्कृत
meaning_en: urban = relating to a city, urbane = having sophisticated and polished manners
example: His urbane manner seemed out of place in the urban slum.

meaning_hi: vain = व्यर्थ / घमंडी, vane = दिशासूचक पंख, vein = नस / रक्तवाहिनी
meaning_en: vain = having no result or too proud, vane = a device showing wind direction, vein = a blood vessel
example: In vain he tried to read the weather vane while blood pulsed through his vein.

meaning_hi: vale = घाटी, veil = घूँघट / परदा
meaning_en: vale = a valley, veil = a thin fabric covering the face
example: The bride's veil trailed behind her as she walked through the misty vale.

meaning_hi: venal = भ्रष्ट / रिश्वतखोर, venial = क्षमायोग्य / हल्का पाप
meaning_en: venal = open to bribery or corruption, venial = a minor sin or fault that can be forgiven
example: A venal official treats every venial slip as an opportunity for a bribe.

meaning_hi: vice = बुराई / उपसर्ग, vise = शिकंजा (यंत्र)
meaning_en: vice = immoral behaviour or a prefix meaning deputy, vise = a clamp tool
example: His one vice was spending hours at the workbench with the vise.

meaning_hi: vow = प्रतिज्ञा, bow = झुकना
meaning_en: vow = a solemn promise, bow = to bend forward
example: He took a vow to bow before no unjust authority.

meaning_hi: wade = पानी में चलना, weighed = तौला गया
meaning_en: wade = to walk through water, weighed = past tense of weigh
example: He weighed his options before deciding to wade across the shallow river.

meaning_hi: wail = विलाप करना / रोना, whale = व्हेल मछली
meaning_en: wail = to cry out in grief, whale = a large sea mammal
example: The child began to wail when the whale disappeared beneath the waves.

meaning_hi: waist = कमर, waste = कचरा / बर्बाद करना
meaning_en: waist = the middle part of the body, waste = to use carelessly
example: Do not waste material by cutting too much from the waist of the dress.

meaning_hi: wait = इंतजार करना, weight = वजन / भार
meaning_en: wait = to stay for someone or something, weight = the heaviness of an object
example: He could not wait to find out the exact weight of the parcel.

meaning_hi: wander = भटकना, wonder = आश्चर्य / सोचना
meaning_en: wander = to roam without direction, wonder = a feeling of amazement
example: She began to wonder why the traveller chose to wander so far.

meaning_hi: war = युद्ध, wore = पहना था
meaning_en: war = armed conflict, wore = past tense of wear
example: The general wore his medals proudly, earned during the long war.

meaning_hi: ware = माल / सामान, wear = पहनना, where = कहाँ
meaning_en: ware = manufactured goods, wear = to have on the body, where = at what place
example: Where does she wear the silver ware on formal occasions?

meaning_hi: warn = चेतावनी देना, worn = घिसा हुआ / पहना हुआ
meaning_en: warn = to alert of danger, worn = past participle of wear or showing signs of use
example: The worn tyres were a sign no one thought to warn the driver about.

meaning_hi: wave = लहर / हाथ हिलाना, waive = माफ करना / छोड़ देना
meaning_en: wave = motion of water or hand, waive = to give up a right
example: She gave a wave and agreed to waive the processing fee.

meaning_hi: weak = कमज़ोर, week = सप्ताह
meaning_en: weak = lacking strength, week = a period of seven days
example: After being ill for a whole week, she still felt very weak.

meaning_hi: weather = मौसम, whether = चाहे / क्या
meaning_en: weather = atmospheric conditions, whether = introducing alternatives
example: Whether or not the weather improves, the event will go on.

meaning_hi: which = कौन सा, witch = चुड़ैल / जादूगरनी
meaning_en: which = used to ask about a choice, witch = a person said to have magical powers
example: Which character in the story is the witch?

meaning_hi: whirled = घुमाया, world = दुनिया
meaning_en: whirled = spun rapidly, world = the earth or existence
example: He whirled the globe and pointed to a random part of the world.

meaning_hi: whither = किस ओर (पुराना), wither = मुरझाना / कमज़ोर पड़ना
meaning_en: whither = to what place (archaic), wither = to become dry and shrivelled
example: Whither shall we go if our ambitions wither without support?

meaning_hi: wholly = पूर्णतः, holy = पवित्र
meaning_en: wholly = completely or entirely, holy = sacred
example: The monk was wholly devoted to his holy calling.

meaning_hi: wine = शराब (अंगूर से बनी), whine = रोना / कराहना
meaning_en: wine = an alcoholic drink made from grapes, whine = to make a complaining sound
example: The child began to whine when refused a sip of the wine.

meaning_hi: wood = लकड़ी / जंगल, would = past/conditional form of will
meaning_en: wood = material from trees, would = used for past habits or conditionals
example: He said he would carve the statue from a block of solid wood.

meaning_hi: yoke = जुआ / बोझ, yolk = अंडे की जर्दी
meaning_en: yoke = a wooden bar joining two animals, or a burden, yolk = the yellow part of an egg
example: The farmer placed the yoke on the oxen and ate an egg whose yolk was bright yellow.

meaning_hi: yore = पुराना जमाना, your = तुम्हारा
meaning_en: yore = time long past, your = belonging to you
example: In days of yore, your ancestors built this very fort.

meaning_hi: zeal = उत्साह / जोश, seal = मुहर / सील / सील मछली
meaning_en: zeal = great enthusiasm, seal = an official stamp, or a marine animal
example: With great zeal, he pressed the official seal onto the document.

meaning_hi: zone = क्षेत्र / इलाका, sown = बोया गया
meaning_en: zone = an area designated for a purpose, sown = past participle of sow
example: The seeds were sown in the agricultural zone near the village.
